title: Gaming Addiction (Internet Gaming Disorder)
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from Internet Gaming Disorder .
Recovery is a journey of reclaiming your time, strengthening self-discipline, restoring healthy relationships,
and creating a balanced, meaningful life. These affirmations encourage mindfulness, resilience, self-worth,
and purposeful living. They are intended to complement professional counseling, healthy lifestyle habits,
accountability, and support from family, friends, or recovery groups.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Gaming can be a healthy form of entertainment when enjoyed in moderation. If gaming is
interfering with your relationships, education, work, sleep, physical health, or emotional well-being,
seeking support from a mental health professional, trusted loved ones, or a support group can help.
Recovery is about restoring balance-not eliminating enjoyment. Every intentional choice you make
is a step toward a healthier, more fulfilling life.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by a game, a score, or a virtual achievement. I am defined by my courage to grow,
my commitment to change, and my determination to build a meaningful life. Every day I choose
balance, I reclaim my time, strengthen my relationships, and invest in my future. One moment, one
decision, and one day at a time, I am creating a life of purpose, freedom, and lasting fulfillment.
